# An instance built at run time and a widget, both under a reactive `if`, are
# null-tested on every target a test can execute on, before and after the
# branch closes and opens again: testdata/ref_null_test_instance.txtar is the
# code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="hit {label} {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main node {
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        button #toggle(text="t", @click { shown = !shown })
        if shown {
            badge #b(label="x")
            text #label(value="y")
        }
    }
}

func testNullTestsFollowTheBranch(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.b != null)
    t.assert(c.label != null)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.b == null)
    t.assert(c.label == null)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.b != null)
    t.assert(c.label != null)
}

window {
    main
}
